primary_frame: Identify factors that drive employee performance ratings
alternative_frames: Predict performance_rating from employee attributes using regression
Segment employees by performance and working conditions
Assess whether training hours and experience improve performance
required_checks: Test pairwise correlations between each feature and performance_rating for statistical significance
Check for multicollinearity among predictor variables
Verify performance_rating distribution supports parametric modeling assumptions
Validate that all salary_band categories have sufficient representation for subgroup analysis
Confirm no data leakage between features and target
Run a global null-model F-test before interpreting any individual coefficients
framing_risks: No explicit target variable is labeled; performance_rating is assumed as target based on schema context
Features may be independently generated noise with no true relationship to the target
Spurious correlations are likely given moderate sample size and multiple features; multiple-testing correction is essential
Zero nulls and uniform ID sequence suggest synthetic data, limiting external validity
salary_band could be a proxy for or consequence of performance_rating, risking circular reasoning
